system.description: Closed Essence 14.3.9 - Matter Shaping. Spells to store and design shapes, mold and shape gas, liquid, and solid matter, alter density and flexibility, and change matter between states.
Allows caster to memorize any one shape he has seen or created (through the use of Modify Stored Shape). A given caster can only have as many shapes stored as he has levels.
Allows caster to alter any 'stored' shape. Caster may combine parts of up to one shape per level into one shape. Shape must be contiguous.
Allows caster to create desired shape from an idea. Shape may then be stored for normal use.

Allows a caster to alter the shape of up to 1 cubic foot per level of any type of gas to move and place portions of the gas with his hands. The shape formed lasts until the duration ends and is then affected normally by the environment. For example Haladan the Vizier, uses this spell to mold smoke from the fireplace into funny animal shapes, pleasing the king and the courtiers.
As Mold Gas, except allows the molding of one type of liquid.
As Mold Gas, except allows the molding of one type of solid.

As Mold Gas, except allows the molding of a material that is either a combination of two of the other three previous materials (lava, mud, etc.), or none of them (energy, plasma, magical energy, living tissue, etc.). This spell confers no immunity to harmful effects of handling these materials.

Allows caster to remove matter from a shape without upsetting the dynamics and/or balance of the object/material. This removed material may be utilized for other purposes. Up to 1% of the present material may be removed per level of the caster.
As Lessen Shape, except that material is added to an object instead of subtracted. This spell does not provide the extra material to be added.

Allows caster to alter the flexibility of a material. Caster may add or remove flexibility. This is reflected in adding +1 to the object's Strength/Reliability per level of the caster (or -1 if the caster wants to remove flexibility).

Allows caster to reduce the density of up to 1 cubic foot of material per level. The density (and therefore weight) can be reduced by up to 5% per level of the caster, but never more than 90% decrease.
Caster can increase the density of up to 1 cubic foot of material per level. The density (and therefore weight) can be increased by up to 5% per level.

Allows caster to alter the shape (with his mind) of up to 1 cubic foot per level of any one type of gas within range. The Altered form will retain it's shape for the duration and afterwards until acted upon by outside forces.
As Shape Gas, except allows the shaping of one type of liquid.
As Shape Gas, except allows the shaping of one type of solid.

As Shape Gas, except allows the shaping of a material that is either a combination of two of the other three previous materials (lava, mud, etc.), or none of them (energy, plasma, magical energy, living tissue, etc.). This spell confers no immunity to harmful effects of handling these materials.

Allows caster to change up to 1 cubic foot per level of one type of gas to a liquid. This change will not alter the temperature in any way (temperature, pressure, etc). The liquid will retain the same qualities it had as a gas (flammable, chemical composition, etc.) but in liquid state.
As Liquify Gas, except material goes from a liquid to a gas.
As Liquify Gas, except material goes from a liquid to a solid.
As Liquify Gas, except material goes from a solid to a liquid.
As Liquify Gas, except material goes from 'other' state to a gas. Living things and magical forces get a RR.
As Liquify Gas, except material goes from 'other' state to a liquid. Living things and magical forces get a RR.
As Liquify Gas, except material goes from 'other' state to a solid. Living things and magical forces get a RR.
